title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Service Operations Agent for conversational admin setup
summary: The roadmap details, consumption licensing and billing command are supported. The claim that Microsoft publishes no agent-specific consumption figure is too broad: its preview industry-template setup experience has a published credit limit per run; narrow the unknown rate to conversational setup. Minor corrections concern abbreviated navigation and checklist controls missing from the table.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a rate, charge or message count specific to Service Operations Agent.
claims.quote: Industry templates in Service Operations Agent help administrators set up an AI-first contact center by using a guided template experience. ... Each industry template-based setup run consumes up to eight Microsoft Copilot Studio AI credits.
claims.fix: Narrow each occurrence to the experience this briefing covers: 'A rate or credit count specific to the Conversational Setup experience is not yet published.' Use the same qualification in licensing.notes, Cost and licensing, the cost rationale and the cost Open question. Do not apply the preview industry-template figure to conversational setup.

claims.fix: Keep the route, but expand its note with: 'Before Select environments, provide the billing-plan name and select the Azure subscription, resource group and Power Platform products; select Next, then choose the region and environment.' These are wizard fields omitted from an otherwise correct route, not a different admin path.
